notes: Fixed: a microphone that stopped answering could freeze Koegaki, so presses did nothing, Quit did nothing, and only Task Manager helped. Each microphone open now has a time limit. If one misses it, Koegaki reports that the microphone is not responding, tries once more on the next press, and restarts itself if that attempt hangs too. While a dictation waits on the microphone, the pill reads Waiting for mic, and its stop button cancels that start instead of letting it go ahead.
